applicationEvidence.reason: Dominica has no required postal-code search key or eligible real postal Polygon/MultiPolygon. Shared runtime/UI tests verify fail-closed area contracts but cannot promote a government office, a UPU address example, draft planning cells, AGID values, synthetic code seeds or Dominican Republic codes.

reproducibility.addressMetadataCorrection: DM JSON, YAML and generated Americas hierarchy now represent postalCode format None, regex/api/rule null and omit the unsupported postcode template token, field and order entries; no code was invented.
reproducibility.geometryTransformation: none; no address, code, coordinate or geometry was copied, transformed or promoted into Git
reproducibility.visualizationDecision: No chart or separate Data App was added because the authoritative denominator is zero postal codes and zero eligible postal geometry; the rollout's canonical Markdown and JSON reports preserve exact receipts and explicit zero counts without implying an area dataset.

limitations: The UPU September 2025 list establishes current no-postcode status; it does not authorize a placeholder code or postal surface.
The UPU Dominica address sheet is dated July 2002; current operator and office references corroborate service continuity but are not complete assignment datasets.
The Dominica government directory describes offices and Parcel Post but does not publish a complete assignment table or postal geometry.
The government and UPU rights pages do not establish compatible processing, derivation, redistribution or public-serving rights for a postal dataset.
Draft DM country-pack localities, planning cells, AGID values, code seeds and test vectors are synthetic planning material and are not Dominica Postal Service assignments.
No browser E2E was run because there is no valid DM postcode input or eligible real DM postal area artifact to render.

Both UPU pages rendered successfully, but the local image-view helper failed with Windows error 206; exact bytes, page counts, text markers, render dimensions and render SHA-256 values were validated.
